chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the recurring verse 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, highlighting the continuous and abundant nature of divine favors (ni'mah) that serve as proof for resurrection and accountability. The rhetorical question underscores the concept of 'tadbir' (divine management) and invites reflection on how one responds to these blessings, linking material and spiritual gifts to the ultimate recognition of Allah's mercy.
